title: Writing / Brand Narrative / Principles
slide_intent: Separate purpose, benefit and method so a reader understands both what the brand offers and why it exists.
strategic_value: A universal-access mission supported by everyday learning stories can make Duolingo’s promise concrete.
demonstration: The left column states the mission and universal invitation; the pale right panel organizes the explanation under Why, What and How.
practical_value: Check that a brand narrative connects its purpose to real situations and the way the service works.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Principles heading above the mission and short invitation at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack Why, What and How at right, with a paragraph explaining access, learner outcomes and playful learning respectively.

reference_purposes.Intent: The Why section explains universal access; How explains using play to make learning enjoyable.
reference_purposes.Application: Three labeled narrative layers give writers a repeatable structure for explaining the offer.
